operation: Apply the formula for the sum of an infinite geometric series
reasoning: The previous expression is the infinite sum \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} ((1/2)z^{-1})^n\). Using the geometric series formula \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} r^n = 1/(1-r)\) with \(r = (1/2)z^{-1}\) yields \(1/(1-(1/2)z^{-1})\), matching the current expression.
